science.subtitle: How It Works
science.description: Lithera works through a 4-stage mechanism of action, each phase building upon the last to deliver comprehensive renal support.

s1.title: Lithotriptic Action
s1.subtitle: Breaking Down Stones
s1.desc: Varun Chhal and Pashanbhed work synergistically to fragment kidney and bladder calculi, dissolving calcium oxalate and phosphate deposits through enzymatic action.

s2.subtitle: Cleansing the Urinary Tract

s3.title: Anti-Inflammatory Shield

s4.title: Cellular Rejuvenation

ingredients.subtitle: Composition
ingredients.description: We combined the wisdom of Ayurveda and the precision of modern pharmacology to create a synergistic formulation for your kidneys.

i1.name: Varun Chhal
i1.desc: A powerful lithotriptic herb that breaks down urinary calculi and prevents stone recurrence. It strengthens bladder tone and promotes healthy urination.

i2.name: Gokhru
i2.desc: Known as "Small Caltrops", this herb acts as a natural diuretic and soothing agent for the urinary tract, easing burning sensations and painful urination.

i3.name: Punarnava
i3.desc: The "Rejuvenator" herb — a potent anti-inflammatory and diuretic that reduces kidney swelling, flushes toxins, and supports renal tissue regeneration.

i4.name: Kulthi
i4.desc: Horse gram powder, a traditional remedy celebrated for its ability to dissolve kidney stones and reduce urinary calcium oxalate crystal formation.

i5.name: Pashanbhed
i5.desc: Literally "Stone Breaker" — this herb has been used for millennia to fragment and expel kidney and bladder stones while preventing future formation.

i6.name: Palash Pushp
i6.desc: The Flame of the Forest flower extract possesses anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, supporting urinary tract health and reducing infection risk.

i7.name: Sarjikakshara
i7.desc: An alkalizing agent that balances urinary pH, creating an environment hostile to stone formation while enhancing the absorption of herbal actives.

i8.name: Apamarga
i8.desc: A renowned Ayurvedic herb for urinary disorders. It promotes diuresis, clears urinary tract obstructions, and supports overall kidney function.

i9.name: Shilajit
i9.desc: The "Destroyer of Weakness" — a mineral-rich resin packed with fulvic acid that revitalises kidney cells, boosts immunity, and accelerates tissue repair.

b1.title: Kidney Stone Dissolution
b1.desc: Breaks down and expels existing kidney and bladder stones through powerful lithotriptic action, preventing painful surgical intervention.

b2.title: Urinary Tract Health
b2.desc: Soothes urinary tract inflammation, relieves burning micturition, and prevents recurrent UTIs with antimicrobial herbal actives.

b3.title: Natural Diuretic
b3.desc: Promotes healthy urine flow and volume without electrolyte imbalance, flushing toxins and stone debris effectively.

b4.title: Anti-Inflammatory
b4.desc: Reduces renal and bladder inflammation, alleviating pain and discomfort associated with kidney disorders and urinary infections.

b5.title: pH Balance
b5.desc: Sarjikakshara alkalises urine pH, creating an environment that inhibits the formation of new kidney stones and crystalline deposits.

b6.title: Renal Cell Repair
b6.desc: Shilajit and Punarnava promote nephron regeneration, enhance glomerular filtration rate, and support long-term kidney function.

audience.desc: Lithera Tablet is formulated for individuals who seek natural, effective kidney care without the harsh side effects of synthetic medications. Whether you're treating existing conditions or investing in prevention, Lithera is your trusted companion.

items.q: What is Lithera Tablet used for?
items.a: Lithera Tablet is an Ayurvedic formulation designed to support kidney and urinary tract health. It is used for dissolving kidney stones (renal calculi), preventing stone recurrence, relieving burning micturition, treating urinary tract infections, and promoting overall renal wellness through its unique blend of 9 potent herbal ingredients.

items.q: How should I take Lithera Tablet?
items.a: The recommended dosage is 1-2 tablets twice daily after meals, or as directed by your physician. Swallow with lukewarm water for optimal absorption. For kidney stone treatment, a course of 2-3 months is generally recommended. For preventive care, a 1-month course repeated quarterly is advised.

Lithera Tablet is formulated with 100% natural Ayurvedic ingredients and is generally well-tolerated with no known significant side effects when taken at recommended doses. However, individuals with pre-existing medical conditions, pregnant or lactating women, and those on prescription medications should consult their healthcare provider before use.

items.q: How long before I see results?
items.a: The onset of action varies depending on the condition being treated. For urinary tract symptoms like burning micturition, relief may be felt within 1-2 weeks. For kidney stone dissolution, noticeable results typically appear within 4-8 weeks of regular use. Preventive benefits accrue over the course of regular supplementation.

items.q: Can Lithera be taken with other medications?
items.a: Lithera Tablet is a natural herbal supplement and is generally compatible with most medications. However, since it contains Sarjikakshara (sodium bicarbonate) which affects urine pH, it is advisable to consult your physician if you are taking prescription medications for kidney disease, blood pressure, or diabetes to ensure there are no interactions.

Each individual ingredient in Lithera Tablet has been extensively studied in both traditional Ayurvedic literature and modern pharmacological research. Herbs like Crataeva nurvala, Tribulus terrestris, and Boerhaavia diffusa have published clinical studies validating their lithotriptic, diuretic, and nephroprotective properties.
